newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba allots 67.5 bln marks in tender at three pct.
newsitem.headline: Buba allots 67.5 bln marks in tender at three pct.

text.p: The Bundesbank on Wednesday said it allocated 67.5 billion marks in securities repurchase funds at this week's tender at a fixed rate of three percent.

The German central bank accepted 39.75 percent of the bids for the 14-day funds. A repo pact for 68 billion marks at a fixed three percent rate expires on Wednesday, so a net 0.5 billion marks is draining from the market.
The Bundesbank said banks bid for 169.8 billion marks of the repurchase funds this week. The repo rate has been fixed at three percent since late August.
